description: What a host sends when a person approves a call whose text is kept (#275), written by hand: the decision of checkpoint.json#/$defs/approvalDecision, with shownDigest the digest of text, the text the person was shown and the text that runs (approvalShownArguments, approvalShownDigest). The member is input only: no checkpoint, event or report holds it, so it asks for no new checkpoint format. Whether a decision holds, for each case, is the decisions rows of kept-text.json; this vector is the record itself, read by the schema, Go and TypeScript.
